name: BookForge Knowledge Catalog Master Specification
purpose: Master blueprint for splitting BookForge knowledge into specialized agent-consumable catalogs.
important_note: This is a knowledge architecture and seed catalog, not a dump of copyrighted books or proprietary databases. Entries should be expanded from licensed, public-domain, official, or independently authored sources.
design_principles: Separate ontology, catalogs, and long-form reference corpus.
Use stable IDs and explicit relationships.
Record provenance and confidence for every nontrivial claim.
Do not treat heuristics or literary scores as objective truth.
Keep genre conventions descriptive rather than prescriptive.
Keep AI-slop signals probabilistic; never claim they prove AI authorship.
Avoid reproducing copyrighted source text; store summaries, concepts, metadata and short lawful references.
Make catalogs retrievable by domain, genre, format, task, agent and workflow.
Allow fiction and nonfiction to share primitives but diverge in domain-specific catalogs.
Design for progressive disclosure: metadata -> entry -> related entries -> source.

entry_contract.source_policy: Every externally-derived rule, taxonomy, standard, or factual claim must carry a source record.
entry_contract.versioning: Entries should be versioned independently and never silently overwritten when meaning changes.
